title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Academic Official Practice Pack
description: Authentic Cambridge 19 Examination Topics featuring high-frequency questions on education, urban living, historical places, and science.
author: Cambridge English Assessment

part1Topics.description: General interest in natural science and inventions
questions: Did you enjoy learning about science when you were in primary school?
What is the most interesting scientific invention in your opinion?
Do you think it is important for everyone to have a basic understanding of science?
Have you ever visited a science museum or exhibition?

part1Topics.description: Buildings, public spaces, and urban atmosphere
questions: Do you prefer living in modern buildings or traditional historic houses?
What is your favorite building in your city, and why do you like it?
How has architecture in your country changed over the last few decades?
Do you think old buildings should be preserved or replaced with modern infrastructure?

part1Topics.description: Foreign language learning and conversational habits
questions: How many languages can you speak?
What do you find most challenging when learning a foreign language?
Do you prefer sending text messages or having a phone conversation?
Do you think English will remain the dominant global lingua franca in the future?

part2CueCards.topic: Describe a historical place or monument you visited
bulletPoints: Where this historical place was located
When and with whom you visited it
What historical significance or story it had
And explain how you felt during and after your visit

part2CueCards.topic: Describe an important decision you made with the help of others
bulletPoints: Who helped or advised you in making it
Why making this decision was difficult for you
And explain how satisfied you are with the outcome

part2CueCards.topic: Describe an outdoor activity or sport you enjoyed recently
bulletPoints: What activity or sport it was
Where and when you participated in it
And explain why you found it enjoyable or refreshing

part3Topics.theme: Historical Tourism, National Identity & Cultural Heritage
questions: Why is it important for a nation to protect and preserve its historic monuments?
Do young people today show as much interest in history as older generations?
How can modern technology, such as virtual reality, help educate the public about history?
Should entry to historical monuments and national museums be completely free for citizens?
Do you think young people should always consult their parents before making major career choices?
Why do some individuals struggle with chronic indecisiveness in the modern era?
How has the availability of big data and online reviews influenced consumer decision making?
Can artificial intelligence make more objective ethical decisions than human leaders?

part3Topics.theme: Public Health, Urban Green Spaces & Fitness Culture
questions: Why are many modern city dwellers spending less time engaging in outdoor recreation?
What responsibilities do city municipal governments have in providing public parks and recreational facilities?
Do you believe team sports teach more valuable life lessons than individual fitness activities?
How might extreme climate change affect outdoor sporting events globally in the coming decades?
